name: Payments
description: Keeps what the instance owes and how it is paid: a checkout, an order, a booking's deposit, an invoice, or a refund of one. The amount due comes from an own integer field or from Holds.total, in a currency. The engine never calls a payment provider: openPayment records an attempt and an action, an adapter outside the engine reads the actions waiting for its provider through listPaymentActions, calls the provider with each action's id as its idempotency key, and reports what happened, and every provider event, through recordPaymentEvent, which applies each event once and moves an attempt only forward. capturePayment, voidPayment and refundPayment record actions too. require holds a move into a state until the instance is authorized or paid, voidOn states void its open attempts, and no move leaves a state while an attempt is processing, so an expiry does not let go of what is being paid for. A refund that needs sign-off is an instance of its own, whose Payments names the instance it refunds (refundOf): entering an issueOn state asks that instance's refundFor, and the provider's answer comes back through settleRefundFor. Payments stores no card data and no raw provider event.

afterRelease.description: What becomes of money captured while the instance is in a voidOn state, such as a payment reported after a hold expired: refund records a refund of it; keep leaves it for an operator. keep when absent.

amount.description: What the instance owes: an own integer field of the type, in the currency's minor units ({ field }), or the claim's Holds.total ({ holds: true }), which carries its currency.

field.description: An own integer field of the type, by JSON key, such as a Finance.Money field.

capture.description: automatic: a provider captures what it authorizes. manual: captureOn states capture it. automatic when absent.

captureOn.description: With capture manual, the states whose entry captures what is authorized.

currency.description: The currency of an amount from a field: an ISO 4217 code, or an own Finance.Currency field of the type ({ field }) that holds one. Holds.total carries its own.

oneOf.description: An ISO 4217 code; the engine checks it is one.

field.description: An own Finance.Currency field of the type, by JSON key.

issueOn.description: With refundOf, the states whose entry asks the linked instance to refund the amount.

record.description: Who reports what providers did: the adapter's principal.

permission.description: The permission recordPaymentEvent needs: the adapter's service holds it.

refundOf.description: Makes the instance a refund of the instance a link names: its amount is refunded from that instance's payments.

link.description: A required, single-valued link of the type's Links config to the instance refunded, which composes Payments.

refunds.description: Who refunds directly; nobody, but a refund instance, when absent.

require.description: Per state of the type's Workflow, what a move into it waits for: authorized, every amount due authorized or paid; paid, every amount due captured.

voidOn.description: The states whose entry cancels the open attempts and voids the authorized ones.

fields.name: due
fields.description: What the instance owes, in the currency's minor units. It does not change while an attempt is open. From Holds.total, it is 0 while the total cannot be read (an item pending, priced items in two currencies, or a sum past what an integer holds), and openPayment and require refuse with total_unknown then.

fields.name: authorized
fields.description: What the provider has authorized and not voided or captured.

fields.name: captured
fields.description: What the provider has captured.

fields.name: refunded
fields.description: What the provider has refunded.

fields.name: outstanding
fields.description: due less captured, never below 0.

fields.name: overpaid
fields.description: What captures brought past what was due, such as a late capture of an attempt that failed while a newer one paid, which Payments asked back with a refund of it.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The ISO 4217 code of every amount.

fields.name: state
fields.description: unpaid, pending (an attempt is open), authorized, paid, partiallyRefunded or refunded. A rule hears it turn paid.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: The last twenty attempts, newest first: { attempt, provider, providerRef?, amount, currency, status, authorized?, captured?, brand?, last4?, openedAt, updatedAt }.

tables.name: attempts
tables.description: On a table, each payment attempt the row opened, keyed by its id: its provider and the provider's reference, its amount, currency and what was due when it opened, its status, what is authorized and captured of it, a card's brand and last four digits, and when it opened and last moved.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: The attempt's id, pay_ and a key the command makes, which the adapter sends its provider as an idempotency key.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Its place among the row's attempts, from 1.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: The key openPayment opened it under.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The provider it is at.

fields.name: providerRef
fields.description: The provider's reference, once the adapter reports it.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What it asks, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: due
fields.description: What was due when it opened.

fields.name: status
fields.description: open, requiresAction, processing, authorized, captured, failed or cancelled.

fields.name: authorized
fields.description: What the provider authorized of it.

fields.name: captured
fields.description: What the provider captured of it.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: A card's brand, for display.

fields.name: last4
fields.description: A card's last four digits, for display.

fields.name: returnUrl
fields.description: Where the provider sends the payer back.

fields.name: openedAt
fields.description: When it opened, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

tables.name: actions
tables.description: On a table, each thing the provider's adapter is to do for the row (create, capture, void, refund), keyed by its id, waiting until an event for it is recorded.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The action's id, act_ and a key the command makes, which the adapter sends its provider as an idempotency key.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Its place among the row's actions, from 1.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: create, capture, void or refund.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: The attempt it acts on.

fields.name: refund
fields.description: For a refund, the refund.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The provider it is for.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What it moves, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was asked, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: doneAt
fields.description: When an event for it was recorded; absent while it waits.

tables.name: refunds
tables.description: On a table, each refund asked of the row, keyed by its id: the attempt it draws on, its amount and reason, its status and what was refunded, and the refund row that asked it, if one did.

fields.name: refund
fields.description: The refund's id, rf_ and a key the command makes.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Its place among the row's refunds, from 1.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: The key it was asked under.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: The captured attempt it draws on.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: That attempt's provider.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What it asks, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why it was asked.

fields.name: status
fields.description: requested, sent, succeeded or failed.

fields.name: refunded
fields.description: What the provider refunded.

fields.name: originSchema
fields.description: The type of the refund row that asked it, through refundFor.

fields.name: originId
fields.description: The key of the refund row that asked it.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was asked, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

tables.name: issues
tables.description: On a refund row (refundOf), each refund it asked of the row it refunds, keyed by the refund's id: its key, amount and currency, its status as the provider settled it, and the Workflow entry it was asked at.

fields.name: refund
fields.description: The refund's id, as the row it refunds recorded it.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Its place among the row's issues, from 1.

fields.name: ofSchema
fields.description: The type of the row it refunds.

fields.name: ofId
fields.description: The key of the row it refunds.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: The key it was asked under: the refund row's type and key and the issue's number.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What it asks, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: status
fields.description: requested, sent, succeeded or failed.

fields.name: refunded
fields.description: What the provider refunded.

fields.name: enteredAt
fields.description: The Workflow's enteredAt when it was asked, which tells a later entry of an issueOn state from this one.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was asked, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

tables.name: events
tables.description: On a table, every provider event recorded, kept for the table as a whole and keyed by its provider and event id, so an event applies once per table and provider: the row it was recorded on, its normalised fields alone, and whether it moved anything. A delete of the row leaves it, so a redelivery is still a repeat.

fields.name: event
fields.description: The provider and the event id, joined by /.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The provider.

fields.name: eventId
fields.description: The provider's event id.

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the row it was recorded on.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What it reported.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Its amount, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Its ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When the provider says it happened, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: The attempt it reported on.

fields.name: providerRef
fields.description: The provider's reference it named.

fields.name: refund
fields.description: The refund it reported on.

fields.name: applied
fields.description: Whether it moved anything.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: At most ten string pairs the adapter passed on.

fields.name: recordedAt
fields.description: When it was recorded, in epoch milliseconds.

operations.name: openPayment
operations.description: Opens a payment attempt for what is outstanding at a provider, and records the action that creates it there, for the provider's adapter; returns the attempt and its amount. The same idempotencyKey returns the same attempt. While an attempt is open, the amount due does not change.

idempotencyKey.description: The caller's key: a repeat with the same key returns what the first call did.

provider.description: The provider's name, as the adapter that serves it knows it, such as stripe.

returnUrl.description: Where the provider sends the payer back to, when it does.

attempt.description: The attempt's id: the idempotency key the adapter sends the provider.

operations.name: recordPaymentEvent
operations.description: Records what a provider did, as its adapter reports it: an attempt's progress, authorization, capture, failure or cancellation, or a refund's outcome. Needs the config's record permission. Each (provider, eventId) applies once, and a repeat changes and writes nothing. An attempt's status only moves forward, so an event that arrives late is recorded and changes nothing.

at.description: When the provider says it happened, in epoch milliseconds.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code; the engine checks it is one.

eventId.description: The provider's id of the event.

last4.description: A card's last four digits, for display.

metadata.description: At most ten string pairs the adapter keeps with the event.

provider.description: The provider's name, as the adapter that serves it knows it, such as stripe.

providerRef.description: The provider's id of the payment.

refund.description: For a refund's outcome: the refund's id.

applied.description: Whether the event moved anything; false for a repeat or a late event.

attempt.description: The attempt's status after it, when it names one.

operations.name: capturePayment
operations.description: Records the action that captures an authorized attempt, all of it or an amount, for the provider's adapter.

action.description: The action's id: the idempotency key the adapter sends the provider.

operations.name: voidPayment
operations.description: Records the action that cancels an open attempt or voids an authorized one, for the provider's adapter.

action.description: The action's id: the idempotency key the adapter sends the provider.

operations.name: refundPayment
operations.description: Records a refund of an amount of what is captured and the action that asks the provider for it. Needs the config's refunds permission. Refused above what is captured, less what is refunded and what refunds already ask. The same idempotencyKey returns the same refund.

idempotencyKey.description: The caller's key: a repeat with the same key returns what the first call did.

action.description: The action's id: the idempotency key the adapter sends the provider.

operations.name: listPaymentActions
operations.description: Lists the actions waiting for a provider across the schema's instances, oldest first, one page at a time: what its adapter is to do. An action stops waiting when an event for it is recorded.

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many; 50 when absent.

provider.description: The provider's name, as the adapter that serves it knows it, such as stripe.

action.description: The action's id: the idempotency key the adapter sends the provider.

at.description: When it was recorded, in epoch milliseconds.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.

operations.name: refundFor
operations.description: Records a refund that a refund instance asks of this one: its Payments' refundOf link must point here, it must be in an issueOn state, the amount must be its own and refundable, and it has no other refund asked or paid. The refund instance's Payments invokes it as the instance enters an issueOn state, under the idempotencyKey it derives from itself and its failed refunds; another key is key_reused, and the same key returns the same refund.

idempotencyKey.description: The caller's key: a repeat with the same key returns what the first call did.

refund.description: The refund instance: its schema and id.

operations.name: settleRefundFor
operations.description: Records on a refund instance the outcome of the refund it asked of the instance it refunds: that instance's Payments invokes it when the provider's refund event is reported there. Needs the config's record permission, and refuses a status or an amount that is not what that instance recorded of the refund.

of.description: The instance refunded: its schema and id.

vetoes.description: A change of what is due, its field or the holds it is the total of, while an attempt is open.
An amount in another currency than the instance's.
A capture past what is authorized.
A refund above what is captured, less what is refunded and what refunds already ask (details: refundable).
A move into a state require holds for paid, while not everything due is captured.
A move into a state require holds for authorized, while not everything due is authorized or captured.
A move out of the instance's state, or a release, while an attempt is processing.
An attempt, a provider reference or a refund the instance does not have.
refundFor from an instance whose refundOf link does not point here, or settleRefundFor from one that is not the instance refunded, or with an outcome that instance did not record.
An idempotencyKey used before with other parameters, or refundFor under a key other than the one the refund instance's Payments derives, or while its refund is asked or paid.
capturePayment or voidPayment of an attempt that is not authorized, or not open, as the action needs.
refundPayment on a type whose config names no refunds permission.

openPayment, or a move into a state require holds, while the amount comes from Holds.total and the total cannot be read: an item is pending, the priced items are in two currencies, or their sum is past what an integer holds.
